EU97: Hau = I. Dhandhai = in the pursuit of Maya. Dhavania = in the running after Maya. Pir = by the Husband, the Master-Prabhu. Vidhan = {vi-dhani} without a husband. Vidhan kar = the conduct of the husbandless.
As long as I am being cheated in the pursuit of Maya, in running after Maya, the Husband-Prabhu has left me because of my husbandless conduct.
I too have been defrauded, chasing after worldly entanglements; my Husband Lord has forsaken me - I practice the evil deeds of a wife without a spouse.
I, a beguilded bride, am running after the worldly affairs. I practise the evil deeds of a spouseless wife and the Groom has forsaken me.
Through ego, (muthrhi) cheated, (vidhankare) grief-stricken, and left by the Husband, you run about in the world's business.
M1DF: Ghar ghar = in every heart. Mahelia = soul-brides. Roorhai = of the beautiful (Prabhu). Het = in love.
The Husband-Prabhu is dwelling in the heart of every soul-bride, and those are beautiful who stay absorbed in love for the Prabhu.
In each and every home, are the brides of the Husband Lord; they gaze upon their Handsome Lord with love and affection.
In every home, are the God Groom's brides: they regard with love and affection their Beauteous Groom.
In every home all are the (mahelia) wives of the Husband, but only those who have love for the dear Husband are (roorhai) beautiful of form.
CVNP: Sahu = ever-abiding. Hau = I. Rahasiarhi = blossoming, joyful. Nam = (joined) in the Name. ||7||
As long as I praise the ever-abiding Husband-Prabhu, my body and mind stay blossoming. ||7||
I sing the Praises of my True Husband Lord, and through the Naam, the Name of my Husband Lord, I blossom forth. ||7||
Sing I the praise of my true Spouse and through the Spouse's Name, bloom I.

I have praised the true Husband, and through the true Husband's Name I have reached the secret joy. The meaning is: the love of the true Husband is the love that never dies and never goes anywhere — why do you weep this false, worldly weeping in vain? ||7|| ☬ Then that woman asks again: how did your true love for the true Husband come about?
C5JY: Gur miliai = if the Guru is met. Ves = the body. Sa dhan = the soul-bride.
If the Guru is met, the soul-bride's very being is transformed; the soul-bride makes the Name of the ever-abiding Prabhu her adornment.
Meeting with the Guru, the soul-bride's dress is transformed, and she is adorned with Truth.
Meeting the Guru, the bride's raiment is changed, and she bedecks herself with Truth.

Then she says: through meeting the Guru our (ves) garb — that is, our nature — has changed; now, being complete in spiritual practice, the true adornment has come. Or: the woman whose garb has changed has received the true adornment.
YQ5Z: O companions! (O friends of the sat sangat!) Come, let us sit together and together remember the Creator.
Come and meet with me, O brides of the Lord; let's meditate in remembrance on the Creator Lord.
Come and meet me, my mates, let us contemplate over the Creator.
So, O companions! Come, meet, and remember the true Creator.
LD27: Baiar = wife. Nam = (joined) in the Name. Sohagani = {the letter 's' carries two vowel signs, (o) and (u); the actual word is 'sohagani', read here as 'suhagani'}.
The soul-bride who is joined to the Prabhu's Name becomes a happy wife; the ever-abiding Prabhu makes her life beautiful.
Through the Naam, the soul-bride becomes the Lord's favorite; she is adorned with Truth.
Through the Name, the bride becomes her Groom's favourite and the True Name is her adorner.
That (baiar) woman has received the name of happy wife, and the true Husband has become the one who adorns her.
53GM: Birharha = separation. Braham bicharo = reflection on Parmatma's virtues. ||8||3||
O Nanak! By singing songs of praise of the Husband-Prabhu, and by reflecting on His virtues, there will never again be separation from Him. ||8||3||
Do not sing the songs of separation, O Nanak; reflect upon God. ||8||3||
So sing not the elegies of separation, O Nanak Rather, meditate you on the Lord's Name.
Sri Guru ji says: sing such a song of reflection on Brahm that there is never (birharha) separation again. ||8||3||
5DJ0: Jin = the Parmatma who. Sirj = having created. Samaia = has absorbed (into Himself). Kudrat janova = know Him to be dwelling in the creation.
The Parmatma who created the world has also kept with Himself the power to absorb it back into Himself; understand that Master to be dwelling in this creation.
The One who creates and dissolves the world - that Lord and Master alone knows His creative power.
He, who fashions and destroys the world, that Lord alone knows His omnipotence.
The One who created the world, and then pervades it — or has absorbed it into Himself — know for certain that He alone is the (kudrat) Master of creation, that is, the Lord of Maya.
1TMR: Sacharha = ever-abiding. Ghat ghat = in every heart. Sabad pachhanova = recognise that Parmatma's Shabad.
One should not try to search for the ever-abiding Parmatma far away (from His creation, somewhere else). Recognise His command at work in every body.
Do not search for the True Lord far away; recognize the Word of the Shabad in each and every heart.
Seek not the True One far. Recognise you, the Lord in every heart.
And do not see the True One as far away; recognise that Brahm with certainty in every heart.
8L1Q: Sabad = command. Sach = ever-abiding. Jin = the Parmatma who. Rachi = made, built.
Do not think of the Parmatma who made this creation as far from it (somewhere apart); recognise His unshakeable command at work (in every body).
Recognize the Shabad, and do not think that the Lord is far away; He created this creation.
Know you the True Lord and think Him not to be far, who has created this universe.
Do not know the Brahm who (rachi) made this world's creation as far away; rather, recognise Him fully in the heart.
B2FK: Pirh kachi = raw in the arena, unable to win against the vices.
When a person remembers Parmatma's Name, then he enjoys spiritual bliss. Without the Prabhu's Name, the world is left powerless.
Meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, one obtains peace; without the Naam, he plays a losing game.
When man remembers the Name, then, gathers he, the bliss. Without the Name plays he, the losing game.
If a being meditates on the Name, then he finds peace; without the Name, this game of human birth is lost in the (pirh) arena — that is, fruitless.
D30W: The Parmatma who made the creation also knows the way to protect it — whatever else anyone may say.
The One who established the Universe, He alone knows the Way; what can anyone say?
He, who establishes the creation, knows the way to sustain it. What can any one say and describe?
The One who established the creation alone knows its method; what could anyone else say to explain His secret?
5RC3: Vataia = spread out. Jal = (the actual reading is 'jalu', read here as 'jalo'). ||1||
The Prabhu who made the world and spread out (over it the net of attachment to Maya) is the accepted Master. ||1||
The One who established the world cast the net of Maya over it; accept Him as your Lord and Master. ||1||
He, who has established the world and cast over it the net of mammon, accept Him as your Master.
The One who established the world and (vataia) cast the net of attachment over beings — that Master alone is the authority. ||1||
0LSA: Baba = O brother! Adh pandhai = halfway, in birth and death. Sansarova = the world.
O brother! Every being that has come (into the world by being born) must surely go (from here); the world is caught in the round of coming and going (birth and death).
O Baba, he has come, and now he must get up and depart; this world is only a way-station.
O father, having, come, man has to arise and go. This world is but a halt-way camp.
O brother! Whoever has come must rise and go; this world is (adh pandhai) halfway along the road.
QRC7: Sir sir = on each one's head. Sacharhai = by the ever-abiding Prabhu. Purab vicharova = purab vichar, reflection on deeds done in the past.
The ever-abiding Parmatma has written on each being's head the destiny of sorrow and joy (to be undergone), according to reflection on the deeds it did in the past.
Upon each and every head, the True Lord writes their destiny of pain and pleasure, according to their past actions.
Reviewing their past actions, the True Lord, writes pain and pleasure in the destinies of all the individuals.
On every head the True One has written sorrow and joy after reflection — or according to deeds done before.
4LS3: Jeha kia = whatever deeds one did.
As a being acted, so Parmatma gave it sorrow and joy. The sum of each being's deeds goes along with it.
He bestows pain and pleasure, according to the deeds done; the record of these deeds stays with the soul.
According to the deeds done, the Lord gives pain and pleasure and they last with the soul.
So as a being has acted, accordingly as God has given sorrow and joy, so it goes along with the being.
Y8CD: (But what power do beings have either?) Whatever deeds the Creator Himself has beings do (those deeds beings do); no being (going outside the Prabhu's will) can do anything else.
He does those deeds which the Creator Lord causes him to do; he attempts no other actions.
The mortal does such deeds, as the Creator makes him to do. He seeks no other job.
As the Creator has one act, so it happens; let one not (bhale) seek any other work — that is, stay intent on Parmeshvar's command.
NXKB: Parmatma Himself is unattached (to deeds); the world is bound in the pursuit (of Maya) by His command. (From these bonds of Maya too) Parmatma Himself is able to set free by His command.
The Lord Himself is detached, while the world is entangled in conflict; by His Command, He emancipates it.
Himself the Lord is detached, but the world is involved in strifes. By His will, He does emancipate it.
Parmeshvar Himself has bound the whole creation in its occupations, and He Himself stays (niralam) apart from all; He alone, by His own command, can set it free.
KDC6: Kal viapai = death comes and presses down. Bhai = in love. Vikaro = vikar, useless deeds. ||2||

"Today (I'll remember Him), tomorrow I will" — death comes and presses down on the one making (these excuses). (Forgetting the Prabhu,) caught in attachment to Maya, he keeps doing useless things. ||2||
He may put this off today, but tomorrow he is seized by death; in love with duality, he practices corruption. ||2||
Attached to duality, the man commits sins, Putting off Lord's meditation till to-day-eve or tomorrow, he is seized by death.
Death overtakes the being, filled with vices through the love of duality, while he says "today, tomorrow" — that is, he dies. ||2||
B986: Marag = road. Panth = road. Ujharh = wilderness. Andh gubarova = andh gubar, pitch darkness.
The being takes the road of Yama and gains no understanding of spiritual life; he stays caught in the wilderness and in pitch darkness.
The path of death is dark and dismal; the way cannot be seen.
The death's path is dismal and utterly dark and the way cannot be discerned.
Now the being does not realise that he has to go on such a road, where there is utter darkness.
SU7Z: Parkaro = kind. Na bhojan parkarova = no food of any kind.
(At the last moment) no water, no quilt, no mattress, no food of any kind,
There is no water, no quilt or mattress, and no food there.
Neither water, quilt and mattress, nor various viands are found there.
— a road on which neither water is found, nor many kinds of food, nor quilts and mattresses.
HFXL: no loving meal, no cool water, no fine clothes, no other adornment (goes along).
He receives no food there, no honor or water, no clothes or decorations.
There, the mortal receives neither food, honour and cold water, nor ornamental costume.
And no one lovingly gives food and cool water, nor are clothes and adornment found.
RBMW: Gal = around the neck. Sir = over the head. Oobhau = standing. Ghar baro = home and hearth, any shelter.
Yama, putting the chain (of attachment) around the being's neck, stands over its head striking blows; then it sees no home or shelter.
The chain is put around his neck, and the Messenger of Death standing over his head strikes him; he cannot see the door of his home.
His neck is chained, death's courier standing over his head strikes him and he sees not home's door (a place for refuge).

No home or door comes into view; a chain lies around the neck, and Yama's messenger (oobhau) standing over the head strikes. ☬ Then the being says: "Take me back to the world now; I will do some charity, giving, repetition and austerity." Then Yama's messengers say:
5H38: Ib ke rahe = sown now. Jamman nahi = do not sprout.
What is sown at that time (of death) (seeds of remembrance, service and the like) cannot sprout. Then he regrets, because the load of the sins he did lies on his head (and cannot be taken off).
The seeds planted on this path do not sprout; bearing the weight of his sins upon his head, he regrets and repents.
The seeds sown on this path sprout not and carrying the load of sins on his head, he regrets.
(Ib ke) what is (rahe) sown now does not sprout. Saying this, they lift the load onto his head, and the being then regrets. Or: the load of shame is on his head — that is, in shame he bows his head.
QDNH: Keep this unshakeable thought in mind: apart from the ever-abiding Parmatma, no one else becomes a companion. ||3||
Without the True Lord, no one is his friend; reflect upon this as true. ||3||
Without the True Lord, none is man's friend. This alone is the true reflection.
Apart from the true Master, a person has no friend at all; this alone is true reflection.
3VC3: Baba = O brother! Rovah = those who come to detachment. Ravah = those who remember the Name. Su = those people. Janiah = receive honour. Mil = meeting (in the sadh sangat). Rovai = whoever becomes detached. Sareva = cherishes.
O brother! The people who remember Parmatma's Name and become detached receive honour (in this world and the next).
O Baba, they alone are known to truly weep and wail, who meet together and weep, chanting the Praises of the Lord.
O father, they alone are known to weep and wail truly, who meeting together, shed tears while uttering Lord's praise.
O brother! Those alone are known as true weepers who, meeting in the sat sangat and dwelling on the virtues of the True One, weep while (ravah) delighting in Him through the Bani.
JNJ2: But the soul-bride whom attachment to Maya has robbed suffers.
Defrauded by Maya and worldly affairs, the weepers weep.
Defrauded by mammon and for the sake of worldly affairs, the bemoaners bemoan.
And those whose understanding has been cheated by Maya — those weepers take the business of worldly dealings to be true.
97NL: Beings (all their lives) wail over the pursuit (of Maya) alone, and so they do not wash off the filth of deeds; for them the world stays just a dream.
They weep for the sake of worldly affairs, and they do not wash off their own filth; the world is merely a dream.
In the dreamy world, they weep for the world's affairs and wash not their filth.
They weep over their occupations and do not wash the filth of the inner self — or do not wash the filth of sin of that dead soul; they stay caught inside the world, which is a dream.
7395: As a juggler (puts on a show, and the being watching stays absorbed in his show, so) the soul-bride cheated by false attachment falls into wandering, stays on the wrong path, and takes pride (in false Maya).
Like the juggler, deceiving by his tricks, one is deluded by egotism, falsehood and illusion.
As is the juggler engaged in his false play, so is the man taking pride in falsehood and illusion.

The intellect — or the creation — cheated in this way, weeps in the pride of false worldly things; as the world is fooled by illusion in a juggler's show, so the being is fooled by the creation of Maya.
770X: But Parmatma Himself is the one who puts (beings) on the right road, and He Himself (pervading beings) is doing the deeds.
The Lord Himself reveals the Path; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.
The Lord Himself is the Shower of path and Himself the Doer of deeds.
That Parmeshvar Himself puts beings on the road; He Himself has all deeds done.
QJ9B: Nam = in the Name. Gur = the Guru. Sahaj = in spiritual steadiness. Subhae = subhai, in the highest love. ||4||4||
O Nanak! Those who, staying settled in spiritual steadiness, stay dyed in the colour of Parmatma's Name — the perfect Guru has saved them (from attachment to Maya). ||4||4||
Those who are imbued with the Naam, are protected by the Perfect Guru, O Nanak; they merge in celestial bliss. ||4||4||
Nanak, they who are imbued with the Name, them, the Perfect Guru naturally protects.
Sri Guru ji says: those who are absorbed in the Name, the perfect Guru has kept safe, and their nature has become peaceful. ||4||4||
S4JV: Baba = O brother! Jhooth = perishable. Pasarova = pasar, expanse.
O brother! (Every being that has) come (into the world by being born) must (in the end) depart (from here); this world is only a perishable expanse.
O Baba, whoever has come, will rise up and leave; this world is merely a false show.
O friend, who-so-ever has come here, shall arise and depart. This world is but a false show.
O brother! Whoever has come must rise and go, because this expanse of the world is false.
A5S9: Sacha = ever-abiding. Sacharhai = the ever-abiding Parmatma. Sach = the ever-abiding Prabhu. Khara = pure, unalloyed. Sachiarova = sachiar, {sach-alaya} fit for the light of the ever-abiding Prabhu.
The person who remembers the ever-abiding Prabhu becomes pure in life; he becomes fit for the light of the ever-abiding Prabhu.
One's true home is obtained by serving the True Lord; real Truth is obtained by being truthful.
The true home, man obtains by serving the True Lord, and the real righteousness by becoming truthful.
So, reaching the true home, which is the sat sangat, let us serve the True One; and, attaining that True One, the soul becomes (khara) utterly (sachiara) true — that is, the very form of Brahm.
C442: Koorh = in attachment to Maya. Lab = in greed. Thai na pasi = is not accepted. Thai = in a place. Thao = place.
The person who stays caught in attachment to Maya, or in greed for Maya, is not accepted in Parmatma's court; he finds no place in the Prabhu's presence.
By falsehood and greed, no place of rest is found, and no place in the world hereafter is obtained.
When through falsehood and avarice, man becomes not acceptable here, he finds no refuge hereafter, either.
(Jan) If, through falsehood and greed, one does not find the place that is the sat sangat here, and is false, then hereafter too, in the next world, he will find no place of peace.
SCP3: As no one (throws a morsel of bread or the like to) a crow that goes into an empty house, (so in the Prabhu's presence) no one will say (to the being caught in attachment to Maya), "Welcome, come on in and sit down."
No one invites him to come in and sit down. He is like a crow in a deserted home.
None says to him "come in Sir and be seated". He is like a crow in a deserted home.
And among good people no one will say, "Come, sit." As a crow at a (sunjai) empty house caws in vain and goes away, so this one too will go just as he came.
XMZY: Vada vechhorha = long separation from Parmatma. Binsai = dies spiritually. Sabae = all beings.

That person has to undergo the round of birth and death; (because of this round) he suffers long separation (from the Prabhu's feet). (Caught in attachment to Maya) the world is bringing on spiritual death (whoever gets caught in attachment) — all of them (die spiritually).
Trapped by birth and death, he is separated from the Lord for such a long time; the whole world is wasting away.
Involved in birth and death one is separated from the Lord, for long. thus is the whole world wasted away.
Birth and death are a great separation; through it all the beings of the world are being destroyed.
Q4EV: Because of greed, the world, caught up in the pursuit of Maya alone, stays astray from the right path of life; so death, standing over its head, keeps making it suffer. ||1||
Greed, worldly entanglements and Maya deceive the world. Death hovers over its head, and causes it to weep. ||1||
Avarice, worldly strifes and wealth beguile the world. Standing over its head, death makes it bewail.
Maya has led the whole world astray in the greed of its occupations, and death stands over its head (rooae) crying out — that is, calling. ||1||

RG8C: Baba = O brother! Bhaiho = O brothers! Gal milah = let us embrace one another, let us sit together lovingly. Deh = let us give.
O brother! O brothers! Come, let us sit together lovingly, and together give blessings (to our departed companion).
Come, O Baba, and Siblings of Destiny - let's join together; take me in your arms, and bless me with your prayers.
Come, O my friends and brothers and meeting me, take me in your arms and bless me.
O brother! O baba! Come, let us embrace, and embracing, give blessings. ☬ What kind of blessings?
S8KN: O brother! The union that lasts forever is only with Parmatma, and the union that lasts forever never ends. Come, let us ask for blessings from Parmatma (let us pray for union with Him).
O Baba, union with the True Lord cannot be broken; bless me with your prayers for union with my Beloved.
O friend, pray for my union with my Beloved. The union with the True Lord sunders never.

Say like this: may the union with the true Beloved never (chukai) move away from you, and keep on in devotion. What union is there for those who are already united with Parmeshvar? They are already united; that is, the union is for seekers.
HJSB: Pray (for the departed companion, and yourselves too) worship Parmatma. Those who once join the Prabhu's feet are never separated again.
Bless me with your prayers, that I may perform devotional worship service to my Lord; for those already united with Him, what is there to unite?
Bless me, that I may perform my Lord's devotional service. Of the already united ones, what more is to be united?
In this way, giving (asisa) cheers to one another, let us worship; and what union is there for the gurmukhs who are already united with Hari?
DYSR: Ik = many beings {plural of the word 'ik'}. Navahu = from the Name. Khelo = khel, the play, the play of life.
But many wander astray from Parmatma's Name, uprooted from the dwelling that lasts forever. Joined to the Guru's Shabad, play the game of remembering the Name.
Some have wandered away from the Name of the Lord, and lost the Path. The Word of the Guru's Shabad is the true game.
Some have strayed away from the Name and the real path. Tell them to play the true game by Guru's instruction.

The self-willed have strayed from the Name, from the (thehahu) place that is the sat sangat, and from the (thavahu) place that is the true form; and the gurmukhs, through the true Shabad, are playing in the True One — that is, rejoicing.
CYPL: Marag = on the road. Sabad = in the Guru's Shabad. Sachai vese = in that Prabhu whose form is ever-abiding.
The people who stay absorbed in the Guru's Shabad do not go on the road of Yama; they stay joined forever to that Parmatma whose form is forever unshakeable.
Do not go on Death's path; remain merged in the Word of the Shabad, the true form throughout the ages.
Let them not tread Death's path, they should remain merged in the Lord, who, in all the ages, has the true From.
Those gurmukhs do not have to go by the road of Yama, because the (sabad) teaching — or Brahm — pervades their inner self, and in age after age their garb is true.
VES1: Sajan sain = O friends and companions! Sanjogi = in the sat sangat. ||2||
O friends, companions, members of the sat sangat! Sit together in the sat sangat. The people who have come into the sat sangat have met the Guru and cut the nooses of attachment to Maya. ||2||
Through good fortune, we meet such friends and relatives, who meet with the Guru, and escape the noose of Death. ||2||
It is through good fortune that we meet such friends and relations, who meeting with the Guru, have loosened the Death's noose.
Meet with (sain) those friends — that is, the saints — because they are united, that is, united with Parmeshvar; meeting the Guru, they have untied their nooses of Maya. ||2||
FXK4: Baba = O brother! Lekh = the command from the Prabhu, according to deeds done, which is to be undergone in the world ahead.
O brother! A being comes into the world naked, and the destiny of sorrow and joy (according to deeds done before) comes written along with it.
O Baba, we come into the world naked, into pain and pleasure, according to the record of our account.
O father mortal comes into the world, all-naked, subject to the recorded writ of pain and pleasure.
O brother! This being has had the destiny of joy and sorrow written according to its deeds, and has come into the world naked.
A6RR: Saha = the time already fixed for a being's death. {Note: among Hindus the time of a girl's and boy's wedding is fixed by the pandit after consulting the Shastras. That fixed 'saha' cannot be moved earlier or later. Just as, through marriage, a girl is sent from her parents' home to her in-laws' home at the reckoned 'saha', so the soul-bride sets out from the parents' home that is the world.} Purab = in the past.
That fixed time cannot be moved earlier or later (nor can the sorrow and joy be stopped from coming) that was earned (as its wages) by deeds done in a former birth.
The call of our pre-ordained destiny cannot be altered; it follows from our past actions.
The destiny's writ, which is in accordance with the past deeds, cannot be altered.
According to the deeds earned before, the (saha) appointed time — that is, the time of dying — does not move.
ESVN: Bah = sitting, having reflected. Sachai = by the ever-abiding Prabhu. Amrit = the amrit of the Name. Bikhia = the poison of Maya. Jit = in whichever direction.

(According to the deeds a being has done) the ever-abiding Parmatma has written, after reflection, whether on the new journey of life the being is to acquire the amrit of the Name or earn the poison of Maya. So wherever the being is set, there it becomes engaged.
The True Lord sits and writes of ambrosial nectar, and bitter poison; as the Lord attaches us, so are we attached.
Sitting down, the True Lord, writes of Nectar and poison and the man attaches to, with which the Lord, him attaches.
The True One Himself sat and wrote both amrit and poison — that is, joy and sorrow; then wherever He set the soul, there it stayed engaged.
4AQ1: Kamaniari = the one who works spells and charms (Maya). Kaman = charms, spells. Gal = around the neck.
(According to that very writing) Maya, the enchantress, casts her spell on the being; she puts a thread of many colours around its neck (that is, Maya enchants it in many ways).
The Charmer, Maya, has worked her charms, and the multi-colored thread is around everyone's neck.
The mammon sorcerer works her sorcery and puts multi-coloured thread around every one's neck.
This (kamaniari) spell-working Maya has cast spells and tied around the neck the many-coloured thread of attachment. The meaning is, the soul is bound by many kinds of attachment.
97U1: (In attachment to Maya) a being's understanding becomes petty, and the mind becomes petty — as a fly eats molasses (and, sticking to the molasses, dies).
Through shallow intellect, the mind becomes shallow, and one eats the fly, along with the sweets.
With the shallow intellect, mind becomes shallow and one eats fly too alongwith the sweets.

Through (hochhi) shallow — that is, trivial — understanding, the mind too has become shallow. The molasses of the senses has eaten that being, the fly. The meaning is: a fly goes to eat molasses, then its feet get caught in it and it dies; in the same way the being goes to enjoy the pleasures of the senses, and then the pleasures consume it.
C9PR: Namarjad = {na-marjad} without covering, naked. Kal = the world. Bandh = bound. ||3||
A being comes into the world naked, without covering, and is driven on ahead bound, still naked. ||3||
Contrary to custom, he comes into the Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and naked he is bound down and sent away again. ||3||
All-naked, against the social custom, the mortal comes into the world and naked is the bound down and despatched.
In imagination the soul was born (na marjad) naked; in the same way it is led away from the world bound, still naked. ||3||
LDSQ: Baba = O brother! Rovahu = weep and wail. Janiarha = the dear relative. Pathaia hai = has been sent off from here.
If anyone must weep (to turn this summons of death aside), then weep and see; but the dear relative whose summons has come is bound and led on ahead (he must go).
O Baba, weep and mourn if you must; the beloved soul is bound and driven off.
O friend, weep if some one must weep, as the beloved soul is goaded on bound down.
O brother! Whoever has to weep, let him weep; your (janiarha) dear one has been bound and led away.
12D0: Dar = from the (Prabhu's) door. Hakararha = the summons.
The written command (of the Prabhu) cannot be erased; the summons that comes from His door (cannot be undone).
The pre-ordained record of destiny cannot be erased; the summons has come from the Lord's Court.
The Lord's writ cannot be erased. The summons have come from the Lord's court.
For the destiny He wrote cannot be erased; the summons from His door has come.
NS23: Ja = when. Tis = to that Prabhu. Rovanhare = the weepers.
When it pleases Parmatma (in His will), the summons (for the being's departure) comes; the relatives who weep, weep.
The messenger comes, when it pleases the Lord, and the mourners begin to mourn.
The messenger comes, when it pleases Him and the mourners begin to weep.
When it seemed good to that Master, then the summons came; the weepers weep. ☬ Who weeps?
5V04: Sons, brothers, nephews, very dear relatives — (all of them) weep.
Sons, brothers, nephews and very dear friends weep and wail.
Wail, the sons, brothers, nephews and the very dear intimates.
Sons, brothers, nephews, and the most dearly loved ones — they all weep.
YU9Z: Bhai = out of fear (of some trouble of their own). Sar = remembering. Ko = any being.
(The relatives of the one who has died) weep in dread, and recall his virtues (the comforts he gave) again and again; but no being ever dies along with the dead.
Let him weep, who weeps in the Fear of God, cherishing the virtues of God. No one dies with the dead.
None dies with the dead. Blessed is he, who cherishing the Lord's merits, weeps in His fear.
No one dies with the dead; having wept, they fall silent. But when one weeps in the fear of Akal Purakh, and in remembering His virtues, then it is excellent.
429N: Jug jug = in every age, always. Si = those people. Jan jana = the wisest of the wise. Rovah = come to detachment, feel separation from the Prabhu. Sach = the ever-abiding Prabhu. Samale = samal, remembering. ||4||5||
O Nanak! Those people are always the wisest of all who, enshrining the virtues of the ever-abiding Prabhu in the heart, turn away from attachment to Maya. ||4||5||
O Nanak, throughout the ages, they are known as wise, who weep, remembering the True Lord. ||4||5||
Nanak, they who wail by remembering the True Lord, are deemed wise all the ages through.
Sri Guru ji says: know those alone as wise in age after age who (samale) dwell on the true Name. ||4||5||
